Drop the overhead that doesn't."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# TokenSlash"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Keep the context that matters. Drop the overhead that doesn't.**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"TokenSlash is a Cordis plugin for **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** that makes agent context more deliberat"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"e. It uses lightweight, structured decisions to select task-relevant tools and prompt sections, keep"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" tool output manageable, and help agents route work without permanently losing access to capabilitie"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"ool output manageable, and help agents route work without permanently losing access to capabilities."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Your agent should spend its context solving the task, not rereading the descriptions of tools it wil"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ould spend its context solving the task, not rereading the descriptions of tools it will never call."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| Capability | What you get |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| **Task-aware prompt pruning** | Selects relevant tool schemas and prompt sections for the current "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"task. |
| **Output and observation hygiene** | Compacts oversized tool results and can mask older ob"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"servations to keep context focused. |
| **Subagent routing** | Uses structured decisions to select m"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"odel tiers and decide when a fork can run with less parent context. |
| **Tool recovery** | Lets an "},{"id":"p8s5","text":"agent inspect a pruned tool's schema or unlock that tool for the current turn. |
| **Workflow guardr"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"ails** | Optional goal, turn-completion, and tool-safety hooks. |
| **Visibility** | In-chat savings"},{"id":"p8s7","text":" telemetry, prune statistics, history, and a settings UI. |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"TokenSlash is configurable rather than one-size-fits-all. Tool pruning supports **normal**, **extrem"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"e**, and **off** modes; tools can be pinned, and individual modules can be enabled or disabled."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Install from GitHub using the DSH plugin manager:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"dsh plugin add github:jessenreinhart/dsh-tokenslash"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Then open the DSH settings for **TokenSlash**, choose a triage provider, and configure the model and"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" module switches for your setup."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- **Default preset:** 9Router Proxy
- **Other presets:** OpenCode Zen, TypeSafe Jev, OpenRouter, Inc"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"eption Labs (Mercury Decide), LocalJev, and a custom endpoint
- **Runtime:** Node.js 20+"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The provider is used for narrow, structured decisions. It is not the conversational model that write"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"s code or answers general questions."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Built-in agent tools"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"TokenSlash adds focused utilities that help an agent use its existing tools more efficiently."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| Tool | Use it for |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| **tokenslash_index** | Get a structural outline of a file: signatures, exports, symbols, and line "},{"id":"p19s2","text":"ranges. Use it to locate the relevant part before requesting a larger read. |
| **tokenslash_batch**"},{"id":"p19s3","text":" | Run independent tool calls in parallel, or run calls sequentially when order matters. |
| **token"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"slash_peek** | Inspect the schema of a pruned tool, or unlock it so the agent can use it during the "},{"id":"p19s5","text":"current turn. |
| **tokenslash_diagnose** | Classify errors and test failures, suggest files to insp"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"ect, or rank candidate tests by relevance. |
| **tokenslash_triage** | Ask the configured decision e"},{"id":"p19s7","text":"ngine a narrow probability or multiple-choice question. |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### A note on triage"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"The triage engine is a **micro-decision engine**, not a chat model. Use it for decisions such as:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- Is this task suitable for a cheaper subagent model?
- Can this fork proceed without the parent's f"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"ull conversation history?
- Which tool group is relevant to this prompt?
- Is this test failure like"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"n history?
- Which tool group is relevant to this prompt?
- Is this test failure likely to be flaky?"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Do not use it to write code, inspect files, search the web, or answer open-ended questions. Keep tho"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"se jobs with the main agent and its normal tools."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## How pruning stays reversible"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"1. **Read the task.** TokenSlash evaluates the current prompt with the configured decision provider."},{"id":"p25s2","text":"
2. **Keep the useful surface.** Relevant tool groups and prompt sections stay available; irrelevant"},{"id":"p25s3","text":" schemas can be pruned.
3. **Recover on demand.** The agent can call **tokenslash_peek** to inspect "},{"id":"p25s4","text":"or unlock a tool that turns out to be needed.
4. **Fail open.** The default configuration favors pre"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"serving normal tool access when triage is unavailable or fails."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"That last point matters: pruning should reduce clutter, not strand an agent halfway through a task."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Most users can configure TokenSlash from the DSH settings UI. The main controls include:"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"| Setting | Purpose |"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"| **Provider / model** | Select a supported decision endpoint and model. |
| **Tool pruning mode** |"},{"id":"p30s2","text":" **normal** for conservative pruning, **extreme** for more aggressive pruning, or **off** to disable"},{"id":"p30s3","text":" tool pruning. |
| **Pinned tools** | Keep named tools available regardless of the pruning decision."},{"id":"p30s4","text":" |
| **Fail open** | Preserve tool access when the decision provider cannot be used. |
| **Modules**"},{"id":"p30s5","text":" | Toggle routing, fork decoupling, prompt pruning, output compaction, observation masking, prefix-c"},{"id":"p30s6","text":"ache alignment, and guardrails. |"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"See docs/TRIAGE.md for provider and decision-format details, and docs/COMPATIBILITY.md for the teste"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"d DSH/Cordis host contracts."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## Benchmarks and measurement"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"Token savings depend on the task, available tool set, DSH runtime, and decision provider. A pruning "},{"id":"p33s2","text":"pass can add overhead when most tools are still relevant, so **there is no fixed savings percentage "},{"id":"p33s3","text":"promised by this project**."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"The repository includes the benchmark harnesses and raw result files so you can inspect the measurem"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"ents and compare them with your own workload:"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"- Single-turn benchmark
- Multi-turn benchmark

- Latest multi-turn resul"},{"id":"p35s2","text":"t
